description: Returns how the market exchange rate between two currencies moved over the past week, month, 3 months or year, ending yesterday: the start and end rate as units of to_currency per one unit of from_currency, the change in absolute terms and percent, and the high, low and average. Use it to answer how much a rate has changed or whether it has dropped or risen by some percentage. It does not notify anyone or watch a rate, and it cannot say what a rate will do next. The rates are daily market rates and leave out the conversion spread the Morse app can include; show get_started_url as the way to continue in the Morse app, where the rate applied to a transfer is shown before the user confirms.

from_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency to convert from, e.g. USD.

period.description: How far back to look, ending yesterday: week, month, 3_months or year.

to_currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency to convert to, e.g. MXN.

name: get_exchange_rate_history
